parts.note: pieces of music that come at the very start, opening a larger work, read as if they were easy tunes for learners

explanation.surface: A request for simple pieces of music suitable for novice players.
explanation.walkthrough: 'For beginners' suggests easy music for learners, but it means music that begins things, played before the main work.
explanation.definitionFit: Introductory pieces that open a suite or fugue are named for coming first, before the main movement.

parts.note: a postponement that tries one's patience, or literally a holding-over of a prisoner until the trial

explanation.surface: Complaining about an annoying wait.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Trying' looks like 'irritating' but means 'awaiting trial': an accused person is held back in custody or on bail until the court hears the case.
explanation.definitionFit: Courts hold an accused person over in custody or on bail pending trial, a legal postponement.

indicators.note: something caught in fabric is held inside it, so one piece sits within the other

parts.note: lace is a delicate openwork fabric
N, north, is a point of the compass

explanation.surface: The tip of a weapon has snagged in some cloth.
explanation.definitionFit: A long spear carried by mounted knights is a classic medieval weapon.

indicators.note: crazy means wild and disordered, so the letters that follow are jumbled

explanation.surface: A reckless driver is going at a mad speed on the road.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Crazy' rearranges the nine letters of ROAD SPEED; the 's after 'person' is 'is'.
explanation.definitionFit: A desperado is a bold, lawless outlaw who takes wild risks.

definitions.meaning: to lengthen or pull out further
slang for a spell served in jail

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both pulling something longer and, in slang, a jail sentence.

definitions.meaning: the Rolling ___, a long-running British rock band

explanation.definitionFit: Pebbles of rock are plural units, and the famous band takes that same plural as its name.

definitions.meaning: a division or rift between groups
a port city on the Dalmatian coast of Croatia

explanation.definitionFit: A rift between factions shares its name with the Croatian coastal city, once part of Yugoslavia.

parts.note: out of fashion is simply out
skirts are items of clothing

explanation.surface: Looking for trimmings to decorate dated clothes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Fringes' looks like decorative tassels but means outer edges, as of a town.
explanation.definitionFit: The outer edges of a town or district are its fringes, synonym.

indicators.note: modifies means changes, so the letters of the preceding words are rearranged

explanation.surface: The passage of time quickly softens how we feel.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Modifies' rearranges the eight letters of TIME SOON.
explanation.definitionFit: Emotions and feelings are synonyms for inner states like joy or anger.

clue.text: Corrects final part in a script

indicators.note: one piece is placed in another, put within its letters

parts.note: MS, manuscript, is a handwritten script
the end is the final part

explanation.surface: An editor fixes the closing section of a manuscript.
explanation.walkthrough: MS is the standard abbreviation for manuscript, the 'script' here; 'in' puts the final part inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: To amend is to correct or revise, a verb synonym in the same tense.

parts.note: R is the abbreviation for Rex, king
elation is great joy

explanation.surface: A man called Rex is described as the brother of a woman named Joy.
explanation.walkthrough: Rex and Joy read as names but are king and happiness; 'perhaps' marks a brother as one example of a family member.
explanation.definitionFit: A brother is one example of a family member, a kinsman.

definitions.meaning: money earned on savings or a stake held in something

explanation.definitionFit: The word covers both money earned on a deposit and a pursuit one enjoys in spare time.

definitions.meaning: to make a garment smaller, as a tailor does

explanation.definitionFit: The phrasal verb means both to dupe someone and to narrow a garment by tailoring.

parts.note: despatch read as killing: a written order authorising an execution

explanation.surface: A delivery slip sent with goods.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Despatch' looks like sending goods, but it also means putting to death, so the note is an order for an execution.
explanation.definitionFit: An official order authorising an execution is a document that sends someone to their end.

clue.text: Decide to put off when on my own

indicators.note: in a down clue, on means placed after, so the second piece follows the first

parts.note: to deter is to put off
something of my own is mine

explanation.surface: Resolving to postpone something when left alone.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Decide to' looks like the definition with 'to' attached, but 'to' is a link; in a down clue 'on' means placed below, so the second piece follows.
explanation.definitionFit: To determine is to resolve or settle on a course, a synonym.

clue.text: A spirit to woo results in engagement for Henry

parts.note: gin is a spirit
to court is to woo

explanation.surface: Gin used as courage before a romantic proposal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Engagement' looks like betrothal, fitting the wooing, but is a battle: Henry V's victory over the French in 1415.
explanation.definitionFit: The 1415 battle won by Henry V against the French was a military engagement.

clue.text: Close associate in team given boot

parts.note: a side is a team
to boot is to kick

explanation.surface: A team-mate who has been kicked out of the team.
explanation.definitionFit: A sidekick is a companion or partner, close helper.

clue.text: Sign language comes before volumes of words

indicators.note: comes before puts the language piece ahead of the sign piece

parts.note: diction is choice of language
Aries is a sign of the zodiac

explanation.surface: Sign language is taught ahead of written vocabulary.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sign language' looks like a single phrase but splits: the sign and the language, with 'comes before' putting DICTION first.
explanation.definitionFit: Reference books listing words and their meanings are volumes of words, description.

clue.text: Dire Straits would be recording ones

indicators.note: dire means dreadful, here a sign that the letters of the next word are in a dreadful mess

explanation.surface: Dire Straits were a rock band, so naturally they would be recording musicians.
explanation.walkthrough: Dire Straits was a British rock band; 'Dire' rearranges STRAITS.
explanation.definitionFit: Musicians who make records are known as recording performers.

clue.text: Four may opt out from revelry in the flesh

indicators.note: opting out from means leaving, so one piece is taken out of the other

parts.note: carnival is a festival of revelry
IV is four in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: Four people might choose to skip the festivities in person.
explanation.walkthrough: 'In the flesh' looks like 'in person' but defines the adjective: of the body.
explanation.definitionFit: Carnal means bodily or sensual, relating to the flesh.

indicators.note: confused means mixed up, so the letters of the next word are scrambled

explanation.surface: Bewildered brides decline something.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Refuse' looks like a verb but is the noun: rubbish.
explanation.definitionFit: Debris is scattered rubbish or waste, a noun synonym.

clue.text: Measures taken for the sake of progress

definitions.text: Measures taken for the sake of progress

parts.words: Measures taken for the sake of progress
parts.note: actions taken towards a goal, also literal strides that move one forward

explanation.surface: Actions taken to make advances.
explanation.definitionFit: Actions towards a goal and footfalls that carry one forward share the same plural noun.

clue.text: Sort of error made by clumsy tic-tac man?

indicators.note: clumsy means awkward and inept, so the letters of tic-tac are badly arranged

parts.note: Al is a man's name

explanation.surface: A bookmaker's signalman at the racecourse makes a mistake.
explanation.walkthrough: A tic-tac man signals odds at British racecourses with hand gestures; 'clumsy' rearranges TICTAC into TACTIC.
explanation.definitionFit: A tactical error is a type of mistake in planning or strategy.

parts.note: the flag is a name for the iris plant

explanation.surface: A flag is flown above a hospital.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Flag' is the yellow wild iris, not a banner; 'on' places H after IRIS in this down clue. Hibernia is the Latin name for Ireland.
explanation.definitionFit: Hibernia was the Roman name for Ireland, so Hibernian means of Ireland.

definitions.meaning: compass-like tools for measuring distances on a drawing
those who rule by splitting opponents, as in divide and rule

explanation.definitionFit: Measuring compasses and, jokingly, rulers who divide their opponents share the one name.

indicators.note: perhaps suggests the following word might take another form, so its letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Trade bodies acting together in harmony.
explanation.definitionFit: Trade bodies representing employees are workers' associations, synonym.

definitions.meaning: balls hit high into the air, as in cricket
people who ski down snowy slopes

explanation.definitionFit: A ball hit high in cricket and a person on skis share the same spelling.

clue.text: The class rioting which scholars carry out

indicators.note: rioting means running wild, so the letters of the class are thrown into disorder

explanation.surface: An unruly class of pupils misbehaving at school.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rioting' rearranges the eight letters of THE CLASS.
explanation.definitionFit: School bags carried by pupils are what scholars take out with them.
